detail: Full summary: the ancestor-membership rule has now produced three separate defects at the 02b seam (ceremony rulings, adapter/mirror writes, acceptance fixtures). Anything that mints an event should be audited for whether it cites the policy it will be judged under; the adapter runtime now does it centrally, but appendRaw callers bypass that path.
